loader.description: Pantalla de carga: Ryu vs M. Bison jugando una partida REAL y correcta de Magic: The Gathering. Vertical 9:16 mobile.
loader.prompt: A humorous and highly detailed 2D anime cel-shaded illustration of a card match in the classic Street Fighter style, vertical portrait composition, aspect ratio 9:16. Ryu and M. Bison are seated properly and facing each other across a wooden table in a traditional Japanese dojo, playing a game of Magic. Ryu sits concentrating intensely on a hand of cards with a focused scowl, while M. Bison sits holding his cards with a smug, evil grin. Both characters hold their cards facing themselves (only the card backs are visible to the camera). On the table, a detailed Magic: The Gathering card layout is displayed: rows of fantasy cards with some cards turned horizontally at 90-degrees to indicate they are tapped, next to a red 20-sided die. A small glowing blue energy Hadouken fireball rises from Ryu's card on the left. Cherry blossom petals drift in from sliding doors in the background. Vibrant cel-shading, polished digital art. --ar 9:16 --no text, watermark, signature, UI, buttons, backward cards
